subject: Mutual Action Plan & signature timeline — Novara procurement sequencing
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <ep@novarahealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft + target signature window

Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I put together a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) to align evaluation milestones, legal gating, and the order form dependencies so we can aim for a clean signature window. The goal here is to make sure procurement, legal, and product acceptance are sequenced so Novara can start the pilot in Q3 without surprises.

Attached: Novara_MAP_v1.xlsx — it includes a lane for Legal (MSA/DPA), Procurement (PO & billing cadence), and Technical Acceptance (pilot success criteria + timeline). Highlights I want to call out:
- Suggested target signature date: 2025-07-31 (flexible)
- Legal review + redline turn = 7 business days
- Procurement PO + finance approvals = 5–8 business days post-legal sign
- Pilot kickoff = 1 week after signature (assuming infra provisioning complete)

Ask: can you confirm procurement's preferred approval window and whether Novara needs any specific DPA language up front? If legal prefers to review an MSA before we iterate on the order form, we'll mark that as a hard dependency in the MAP.

I copied Grace (onboarding lead) so we can include acceptance criteria and provisioning tasks in the same doc.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Novara_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 72KB)

Date: 2025-06-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + target signature window

Camila —

Thanks for the MAP. Procurement likes the visibility this provides. Quick responses:
- Target signature: 2025-07-31 works as a stretch objective, but our internal funding committee meets 2025-07-15 and we'd like contract in place before their July 31 deadline.
- Legal: Greg (copied via separate thread) will need to review the MSA and DPA. He typically asks for 10 business days for first review + 3 business days for responses to our comments.
- Procurement: finance prefers invoices on a net-45 cadence; PO issuance typically takes 5 business days after legal's thumbs-up.

I've attached Novara's procurement questionnaire (excerpt) with a couple of vendor-specific questions about data residency and audit logs. Can your team confirm whether audit-log retention and SOC2 evidence are in-scope?

Also looping Tom (ops) who will own infrastructure readiness questions.

Elena
Elena Park
Director, Procurement — Novara Health
ep@novarahealth.com

Priyom / Laura —

Looping you both in to align on sequencing. Quick notes from our side:
- Priyom: can your team confirm an acceptance-test checklist (technical gating) that we can add to the MAP? Ideally 3–4 plug-and-play validation tasks (latency/throughput smoke tests, KV-cache behavior, sample dataset run). If we can deliver that by EOD 6/9 I can incorporate into the acceptance lane.
- Laura: based on Elena's timeline, MSA/DPA first review will be the gating item. Can we commit to a 5-business-day turnaround on Redwood's initial pass (we'll push to expedite) and then 3 business days for followups? I'll flag clauses where order form pricing depends on reserved capacity commitments so legal knows order form can't be finalized until those knobs are set.

Attached: Novara_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated master with a technical acceptance tab). I added a column for 'hard dependency' — MSA approval required before Order Form finalization.

Grace — please add the onboarding checklist items so Novara sees infra tasks tied to the timeline.

Thanks —
Camila

Camila / team —

Attached is our initial MSA pass with high-level redlines and three open questions where Novara input is required:
1) Data residency language — Novara has asked us to specify EU vs US controls for backup copies. We currently commit production data residency; backups live in multi-region by default. Legal wants explicit DPA language if backups are required to stay in-region.
2) Liability cap — Novara proposed a cap tied to annual subscription; we need procurement to confirm which year/term they prefer so we can mirror that in the order form.
3) Acceptance criteria — order form references the acceptance checklist; we need Priyom's team to provide pass/fail gates to call out in the OF.

I can turn around Redwood's next pass in 3 business days after Novara answers the three items above.

Attachment: MSA_draft_redlines_20250610.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

- Updated target signature window: 2025-07-15 to 2025-07-31 (Novara funding committee preference noted)
- Legal gating: MSA/DPA first review expected 10 business days; Redwood to respond within 3 business days on redlines to help compress total cycle
- Procurement gating: PO issuance planned within 5 business days of final signature; finance prefers net-45 invoicing (noted)
- Technical gating: Priyom's acceptance checklist (latency/throughput/basic security checks) will be attached to Order Form; failure criteria and remediation plan included

Next actions (can we get confirmations by 2025-06-16?):

2) Redwood Legal: next MSA pass ready by 2025-06-14 pending answers
3) Priyom: post acceptance checklist to the MAP by 2025-06-09 (if you can't make that, confirm ETA)
4) Ops: Tom to confirm infra provisioning ETA for pilot (we estimate 5 business days post-signature)

I'm happy to run a 30-minute alignment call if that would help compress timelines — propose 2025-06-12 10:00 AM PT.
